raw_text: [[File:{{{Alt}}}|28px|link=]] "Slowly regenerates health and bursts into damaging Flames when Dragon Duke falls" Contents 1 Summary 2 Strategies 3 Statistics 4 History 5 Audio 6 Trivia Summary [ ] The Fire Heart is a piece of Common Hero Equipment for the Dragon Duke . It is one of two pieces of Hero Equipment that the Dragon Duke starts with, the other being the Flame Blower . The Fire Heart appears as a heart with claw-like spikes poking out on the left behind the right, and a hole on the right with fire spilling out. When equipped, it grants a large amount of health regeneration and a death explosion to the Dragon Duke. The death explosion can only trigger once, for the first time the Dragon Duke falls. If he is revived later, his subsequent defeats will not cause an explosion. In addition, the Fire Heart grants additional hitpoints to the Dragon Duke.
